# VideoTutor

> > VideoTutor is an educational platform offering curated calculus and mathematics video content through an interactive learning studio.

The platform provides recommended educational videos focused on calculus and mathematics instruction. VideoTutor features content from educators including Kai Zhao, Yan Huang, Michael Manganello, and Yang Li, organized through a learning studio interface available in multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- calculus
- mathematics
- learning studio
- educational videos
- video library
- recommended content
- Kai Zhao

- educational content
- recent videos

## Learning Studio

- [Learning Studio - Recommended Videos (English)](https://videotutor.io/en/learning-studio/recommended): English version of the learning studio featuring recommended calculus and educational videos
- [Learning Studio - Recommended Videos (Chinese)](https://videotutor.io/zh/learning-studio/recommended): Chinese version of the learning studio with recommended calculus and math educational videos
